result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the bottom navigation is overlapped and obscured by a thick black bar.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is obscured by a thick black horizontal bar overlapping the middle icons (search and saved), making them partially hidden and hard to recognize/tap.
issues.suggestion: Ensure bottom navigation has proper safe-area padding and is not overlapped by the system gesture indicator; move the indicator below the navigation and keep all icons fully visible.
